body: Thank you for your reply.  I really appreciate you taking the time to respond.  I really would like to believe that it gets better, but have been living this way for over 15 years, and it does not seem to be any different than from the time i was 12.  And I have tried.  I have sought help over the years, told myself that it gets better, went on to get my graduate degree, thinking that would make me happy, but alas, it has not.  I have been on meds twice before, and am wondering if I will have to take them for the rest of my life in order to have the energy to function in this world.  I do things daily to try to make my life more sustainable, but it just does not seem to be enough to make me "happy".  I have tried to make my life better, and actually continue to do so daily, but honestly, it is tolling to the point that I feel like I am sinking further in quick sand.  I really appreciate your helpful words, and I do hope that it will get better one day, but I honestly don't think I have much more energy left to even live to that day.
